name: The Velvet Pendulum
prompt: Hang one fat silver weight above a floor of loosely arranged plum velvet cushions. As it swings, a fine stream of sand draws broad loops between reclining neighbours. An attendant delicately moves a cushion out of the next loop.

name: The Room That Blinks
prompt: Make two enormous shallow eyelids of green pleated silk shelter a white oval hall. A wheel slowly opens them toward the daylight. Guests paint what they remember of the room during the interval of darkness.

name: The Spiral Guests
prompt: Lay a loose spiral of blue reclining chairs increasing steadily in size toward its centre. A single scarlet scarf runs through every pair of armrests. Guests relay a tiny tug along the scarf with their eyes closed.

name: The Candle Exchange
prompt: Arrange slender black candle stands in two opposing ranks across a mirrored floor. Visitors pass a flame down each side with long tapers. One standing figure at the far end waits where the two wandering reflections meet.

name: The Cabinet of Soft Thunder
prompt: Build a low kidney-shaped room of translucent stretched drumskin. Guests lounge outside with fingertips against the skin while attendants roll padded balls around inside. The balls' positions show as soft shadows travelling just behind the surface.
